title: Homework, lesson 108: Learn the 12 circuit symbols on the portal sheet; complete the symbols quiz.
subject: Science (GCSE Biology, Chemistry, Physics)
source: Seeded from gcse-science/y10 lesson 108 (Learn the 12 circuit symbols on the portal sheet; complete the symbols quiz.)
intro: Covers lessons 26 to 109 of Respiration, moles and electricity. Answer every question. For multiple choice, fill in one circle.

questions.q: Where is bile made?
questions.a: C) Liver. Bile is made in the liver and stored in the gall bladder.

questions.q: Which products are made when yeast respires anaerobically?
questions.a: B) Ethanol and carbon dioxide. Yeast fermentation gives ethanol and carbon dioxide. Lactic acid is produced in animal muscle.

questions.q: During inhalation, what happens to the pressure in the chest?
questions.a: B) It falls as volume rises. The chest volume increases so the pressure falls below atmospheric pressure and air flows in.

questions.q: What is the Mr of magnesium hydroxide, Mg(OH)₂? (Ar: Mg 24, O 16, H 1)
questions.a: C) 58. Mr = 24 + 2 × (16 + 1) = 58. Doubling only the H gives 42, and counting one OH gives 41.

questions.q: A compound contains 6.0 g carbon and 1.0 g hydrogen. What is its empirical formula? (Ar: C 12, H 1)
questions.a: B) CH₂. C: 6 ÷ 12 = 0.5 mol; H: 1 ÷ 1 = 1.0 mol. Ratio 1:2, giving CH₂.

questions.q: Two identical bulbs are in parallel across a 6 V cell. What is the voltage across each bulb?
questions.a: B) 6 V. Each parallel branch has the full supply voltage of 6 V. 3 V would be the share in series.

questions.q: A 9.0 V battery transfers 54 J of energy. How much charge has passed?
questions.a: A) 6.0 C. Q = E ÷ V = 54 ÷ 9.0 = 6.0 C. 486 comes from multiplying instead of dividing.

questions.q: Which statement about bile is correct?
options: It is made in the gall bladder and digests lipids
It is made in the liver and emulsifies lipids
It is made in the pancreas and neutralises acid
It is an enzyme that breaks down fats
questions.a: B) It is made in the liver and emulsifies lipids. Bile is made in the liver, stored in the gall bladder, and it emulsifies lipids and neutralises acid. It is not an enzyme and it is not made in the pancreas.

questions.q: Two resistors are in series with a 9 V supply. The current in the first is 0.3 A. What is the current in the second?
questions.a: B) 0.3 A. In a series circuit the same current flows through every component.

questions.q: Three identical lamps are connected in parallel to a 6 V cell. What is the voltage across each lamp?
questions.a: B) 6 V. Each branch of a parallel circuit has the full cell voltage, so 6 V.

questions.q: Which is balanced?
questions.a: B) N₂ + 3H₂ → 2NH₃. Left: 2 N, 6 H; right: 2 N, 6 H.

questions.q: Why are the peas in flask B boiled?
options: To kill them as a control
questions.a: B) To kill them as a control. Dead peas cannot respire, so any rise in A must be due to respiration.

questions.q: 9 V across a resistor, current 0.3 A. Resistance?
How is a voltmeter connected?
questions.a: B) In parallel with the component. A voltmeter measures the potential difference across a component, so it goes in parallel.

questions.q: Emphysema reduces gas exchange because...
options: alveoli walls break down, reducing surface area
questions.a: B) alveoli walls break down, reducing surface area. Fewer, larger air spaces give less surface area for diffusion.

questions.q: Bile is stored in the...
questions.a: Gall bladder

questions.q: Digested food is absorbed mainly in the...
questions.a: Small intestine

questions.q: Respiration happens in...
questions.a: Every living cell

questions.q: Products of anaerobic respiration in yeast?
questions.a: Ethanol and carbon dioxide

questions.q: Gas exchange happens in the...
questions.a: Alveoli
